entities.name: Walter Martínez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Walter Nelson Martínez Martínez was a Venezuelan award-winning journalist, originally from Uruguay. Martínez's career spanned over three decades in radio, television and the press. He was best known for his work in international relations, and also for using a patch in his right eye, due to a home plumbing accident.
